name: Naturalisation -- Reduced Period for Spouses of Austrian Citizens

requirements.blocker_text: Marriage or registered partnership to an Austrian citizen reduces the residence requirement to 6 years, while all other naturalisation criteria (language, income, conduct, civics) still apply. Authorities are reported to scrutinize relationship authenticity closely.

6 years of residence while married/partnered to an Austrian citizen, in place of the standard 10-year track -- figure sourced only to tier-3/4 secondary guides, not confirmed against a tier-1 Austrian government citation in this pass.
All general naturalisation conditions still apply: B1 German, stable income, Wertekurs/history test, clean record, and renunciation of prior citizenship (see at_naturalisation.json).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 6 years' residence while married/partnered
Standard naturalisation documents (language, income, civics, conduct)
